title: Fix renaming symbol in files with unsaved changes
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Renaming a symbol (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117949) present in an unsaved file uses the old file state for code lookup. This can cause crashes (when the symbol is present in a line out of bounds of the old file) and code lookup issues.

## Additional information

The PR changes the code to check if the file is open in an editor, if so the potentially unsaved text from it is used for code lookup. I reused an existing function but had to adjust its return type.
